grand-conjuration.file: Ghost Reveries (2005)/Opeth - Ghost Reveries - 07 - The Grand Conjuration.flac
grand-conjuration.note: Opening riff. Replaces Ghost of Perdition as the riff test (owner, 2026-11-08). PROVISIONAL times from sections.py (no vocals until ~1:23; guitar level changes ~0:25); owner to confirm. Tuning DADFAE = D2 A2 D3 F3 A3 E4 (owner, 2026-11-10). Reference: the intro of a UG tab by immortal_stone, typed into /srv/guitar-buddy/work/grand-conjuration/reference.txt (never commit); that tab says D A D F# A D, which the owner says is wrong but close. Guitar stem is two guitars panned hard L/R (L/R correlation 0.06); scored against the intro, right finds 56% of notes, both 52%, left 46%, so channel=right.
